conservation.condition_narrative: Previous conservation addressed an area of discoloration at mid-center, determined to be a reworking by the artist. Conservation also reduced old, smudged areas along the edges, but darkening is still visible.
conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by The McNay in 2025.
conservation.technical_description:
The object is executed with oil on canvas. Stretcher bar images are apparent, especially in the upper section of the painting. There are several small losses along both corners near the frame edge. Other possible pinpoint losses are present on the canvas, visible as white specks, but may be the result of the thin paint layer. There are a few dark specks on the canvas in the upper left and lower right quadrants. 
 
The metal strip frame is the artist’s original construction. Three corners are out of alignment, two along the top edge and one at the bottom left. The top edge is no longer straight, lifting slightly from the canvas. Darkening and discoloration are by design.

remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks indicates about the 1955 New York (Downtown— O'Keeffe) exhibition, "This was not hung on floor with show; although catalogued. — D.B." Backing inscription, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1953. O'Keeffe wrote: "When that large painting 'From the Plains' returns from the Nat Inst. will you please return both 'From the Plains' [see also cat. no. 1274] to me. My next big painting I'm going to paint on the wall so I can't send it anywhere" (O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 18 September 1952, Archive of American Art). "I could send one that is four feet by seven — it is that yellow streak you returned to me done over as a horizontal — the color much brighter" (O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 8 August 1954, Archive of American Art). Titled *From the Plains I* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Zigzagging forms in yellow and pink arch over a field of green paint. The forms create a rainbow-like shape over the abstract scene. Two thin bands of pink run across the bottom of the work.
title: From the Plains
